characters.name: Den yngste sønnen (Mestertyven)
characters.description: Den yngste av tre brødre, en vennlig og oppfinnsom gutt som lærer å snike seg til ting, men som også har et godt hjerte og retter opp det som blir galt.
characters.look: A slim, nimble young man of about twenty with a narrow, clever face, a pointed chin, quick dark-brown eyes under arched eyebrows, a sly lopsided grin and a thin black moustache. Short curly black hair pokes out from under a small dark-grey felt hat with a narrow brim, always worn tilted over one eye. He wears a long, patched bottle-green coat with deep pockets over a cream shirt, a red neckerchief, narrow charcoal trousers and soft black boots.

characters.name: Mestertyven i uniform
characters.description: Mestertyven i en uniform med gullsnorer og blanke knapper, som han fant blant røverskattene. Slik rir han hjem til faren, som nesten ikke kjenner ham igjen.
characters.look: The master thief dressed up as a grand general: the same slim young man of about twenty with a narrow, clever face, a sly lopsided grin, a thin black moustache and short curly black hair. He wears a black two-cornered hat with a white plume, a navy-blue uniform coat with two rows of shiny brass buttons, gold cords looped across the chest and gold-fringed epaulettes, a wide red sash, white breeches and tall polished black riding boots.

characters.name: Mestertyven som fillegutt
characters.description: Mestertyven forkledd som en fillete gutt med en sekk. Ingen ser noe rart ved ham, men i sekken har han tre levende harer.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a ragged beggar boy: the same slim young man with a narrow, clever face, a sly lopsided grin and a thin black moustache, his cheeks smudged with dirt. He wears a torn, floppy straw hat, a baggy sackcloth smock full of holes and patches tied with string, and frayed trousers rolled up to the knees, and goes barefoot, with a big patched brown sack over one shoulder.

characters.name: Mestertyven som engel
characters.description: Mestertyven med et hvitt laken over seg og vinger av gåsefjær på ryggen. Slik lurer han presten til å tro at han skal til himmelen.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as an angel: the same slim young man with a narrow, clever face, a sly lopsided grin and a thin black moustache. A big white bed sheet is draped over his head and body like a long hooded robe, leaving his face free, and two huge home-made wings of grey-and-white goose feathers are tied onto his back with string, a little crooked. His bare feet peek out below the sheet.

characters.name: Mestertyven som kjerring
characters.description: Mestertyven forkledd som ei gammel, krokete kjerring med stav og filler. Hun fryser så fælt og vil bare sitte litt innenfor stalldøra.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a crooked old beggar woman: a stooped, limping figure leaning on a knobbly wooden staff. A faded black headscarf is pulled low over a tangled grey wig, but a thin black moustache and a sly grin peek out underneath. She wears a patched grey horse blanket as a shawl, a ragged brown skirt that is too short, showing big muddy boots, and a torn apron with a deep pocket.

characters.name: Mestertyven med geiteskjegg
characters.description: Mestertyven forkledd som en fillete mann med et stort, bustete skjegg av geitehår. Han skal i bryllup med ei tønne og holder fingeren i hullet hele tida.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a shabby old carter: the same slim young man with sly, narrow eyes, but his face is almost hidden behind a huge, bushy false beard of shaggy grey-white goat hair that reaches down to his belt. He wears a squashed, wide-brimmed black hat, a ragged mud-brown coat tied with rope, patched knee breeches and worn clogs.

characters.name: Den gamle kona i huset
characters.description: En sliten, men godhjertet gammel kvinne som advarer gutten og håper han skal klare seg, og som til slutt blir møtt med takknemlighet.
characters.look: A short, round, jolly old woman of about seventy with bright red apple cheeks, a button nose, twinkling blue eyes, deep laugh lines and wisps of white hair escaping from a red-and-white checked headscarf tied under her chin. She wears a long dark-brown wool dress with the sleeves pushed up, a wide sunflower-yellow apron with a big pocket and sturdy clogs, and keeps a big wooden ladle tucked into her apron strings.

characters.name: Husmannen
characters.description: Faren til mestertyven, en fattig husmann som ikke har noe å gi sønnene sine. Han er redd for fine folk, men sitter stolt øverst ved bordet i bryllupet.
characters.look: A thin, timid old cottager of about sixty-five with a long, droopy, worried face, big sad grey eyes under bushy brows, a red-tipped nose, sunken cheeks with grey stubble and thin grey hair sticking up in tufts. He wears a threadbare, patched mouse-brown smock tied with a cord, baggy patched trousers and old clogs, with a worn grey-and-blue striped blanket wrapped round his shoulders like a shawl.

characters.name: Bonden med oksene
characters.description: En snill bonde som skal til byen og selge oksene sine, og som blir lurt tre ganger på den samme veien. Kona hans er så sur at han bare tør å plystre langt ute på jordet.
characters.look: A big, broad, soft-hearted farmer of about forty with a round, sunburnt face, a bulbous red nose, small worried blue eyes, large ears and a short, curly light-brown beard. He wears a battered brown felt hat, a woolly sheepskin vest over a blue work shirt with rolled-up sleeves and brown trousers tucked into muddy boots, and carries a long coiled rope over one shoulder.

characters.name: Amtmannen
characters.description: En rik og selvsikker mann som setter prøver for å teste gutten, og som ender med å le av sin egen overraskelse og holde ord.
characters.look: A stout, self-important gentleman of about fifty-five with a huge round belly, a pink double chin, rosy jowls, small twinkling eyes, a snub nose, a neat grey moustache waxed into two curly tips and grey hair curling over his ears. He wears a round-crowned black hat, a tobacco-brown frock coat with brass buttons over a canary-yellow waistcoat stretched tight across his belly, a gold watch chain, grey striped trousers and shiny black shoes.

characters.name: Amtmannens datter
characters.description: Amtmannens snille og kloke datter, som står i døra og smiler når faren setter den første prøven, og som til slutt selv sier ja til mestertyven.
characters.look: A kind, clever young woman of about nineteen with a heart-shaped face, a dimple in one cheek, lively grey-green eyes that always seem to be laughing, a small straight nose and nut-brown hair in two braids coiled into round buns over her ears. She wears a long apricot-coloured dress with a white embroidered collar and puffed sleeves, and a sprig of white lily of the valley pinned at her collar.

characters.name: Presten
characters.description: En stolt, men ufarlig skikkelse som blir lurt på en måte som mest er pinlig og morsom, og som lærer å være litt mer forsiktig.
characters.look: A tall, stiff, very proud priest of about fifty with a long thin face, a long pointed nose held high, raised eyebrows, a small pursed mouth and a long, pointed sandy-grey beard. He wears a round, wide-brimmed black hat, a long black cassock buttoned to the chin, a big white pleated millstone ruff around his neck and black buckled shoes, and clasps a small black hymn book to his chest.

places.name: the Forest Road
places.look: A narrow, dusty dirt road winding through a light forest of white-trunked birches and dark spruces, with a grassy ditch along one side, big mossy grey stones and round green bushes at the roadside, and a weathered grey wooden rail fence where the road bends. Here and there a big old birch leans over the road with a thick, low branch.

places.name: the Manor Farm

On one side stands a grand two-storey manor house of white-painted timber with a dark hipped roof, rows of small-paned windows with green shutters, a carved front porch and a bed of red and yellow tulips under the upstairs windows. Around the yard stand a long red stable, a small red goose house and a kitchen wing, with blossoming apple trees and birches behind.
